Key quote from CTO on 2026-02-12 call: 'We get unpredictable bursts after new releases — users spam the chat and we see time-limited surges that blow past our concurrency limits.'

Risk: concerned about opaque 429s causing poor UX; wants per-customer quotas and transparent headers to surface to frontend.

technical_requirements: Per-account concurrency limit target: starting 200 concurrent requests, ability to request temporary burst to 1k for 1-2 hours

Async fallback: ability to enqueue requests (webhook callback) for long-running operations
Observability: per-route latency and token cost breakdown, per-account quota dashboards
